parameters.name: AccountName
parameters.description: The username of the database account.

parameters.name: AccountPassword
parameters.description: The password of the database account.

parameters.name: FullPlan
parameters.description:
The full backup policy. The value is in JSON format and contains the following fields:

- **start**: the backup start time.
- **interval**: the interval.
- **type**: the unit of the interval.
- **days**: the days of the week on which the backup is performed.

parameters.name: IncPlan
parameters.description:
The incremental backup policy. The value is in JSON format and contains the following fields:
- **start**: the backup start time.
- **interval**: the interval.
- **type**: the unit of the interval.
- **days**: the days of the week on which the backup is performed.

parameters.name: PolicyId
parameters.description:
The ID of the anti-ransomware backup policy for databases.
>You can call the [DescribeUniBackupPolicies](~~DescribeUniBackupPolicies~~) operation to obtain this parameter.

parameters.name: PolicyName
parameters.description: The name of the anti-ransomware backup policy for databases.

parameters.name: PolicyStatus
parameters.description:
The status of the policy. Valid values:
- **enabled**: The policy is enabled.
- **disabled**: The policy is disabled.

parameters.name: Retention
parameters.description: The number of days for which backup snapshots are retained.

parameters.name: SpeedLimiter
parameters.description: The network bandwidth throttling for backup network bandwidth. Unit: bytes.
